outOfScope: Performing the BB-065 objective migration inside BB-082 implementation.
Letting ordinary RESEARCH_SA/WORKER candidates change their own objective/routing trust subject.
Reconstructing version chains in current context or retaining duplicate current objective/plan siblings.
Using supersession to mark work DONE, accept product truth, bypass dependencies or mutate delivered task history.
constraints: Ordinary research evaluation continues to copy objective/Board authority from exact PR-base trusted data; candidate source cannot redefine its own semantic subject.
Supersession is a dedicated control-plane publication verified by trusted-base code against exact base/head content; candidate supersession code is never executed by the verifier.
Supersession applies only to unfinished RESEARCH_SA targets. WORKER input contradictions must first return through the existing research path; DONE tasks are immutable.
The publication binds exact trustedBaseSha, old objective ref/hash, replacement ref/hash, target plan ref, reason/evidence and the complete direct-dependent set.
Target is reset to PLANNED RESEARCH_SA/RESEARCH, claim/currentContext removed, plan DRAFT rebound to the replacement objective, and stale readiness/evaluation/worker bindings removed.

Every non-DONE direct dependent is listed. A READY/WORKER direct dependent is conservatively reset to research/DRAFT; a RESEARCH_SA dependent remains research; DONE dependents remain historical and unchanged.

Canonical objective/plan paths stay stable. The current supersession relation has one canonical receipt; Git history retains prior bodies/receipts rather than adding generation/version artifacts to context.
A later correction is another explicit supersession from the then-current objective; no hidden rollback or history rewrite.
BB-065 remains BLOCKED until BB-082 is delivered; its replacement objective is published only in a separate migration PR.
invariants: Candidate-controlled content cannot redefine the semantic subject judged by ordinary Jev.
Supersession is freshness-fenced to exact prior objective and Board state; stale/lost-update publication fails closed.
Supersession revokes stale execution/readiness authority while preserving canonical history and task identity.
All direct dependency impact is explicit; ready downstream work cannot silently survive changed prerequisite semantics.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Add OBJECTIVE_SUPERSESSION as a typed Blackboard artifact and one canonical receipt path `docs/blackboard/artifacts/objective/<WORK_ID>.supersession.json`; it is a current relation, not an objective version.
D2 — Receipt pins targetWorkId, trustedBaseSha, oldObjective(ref/hash), replacementObjective(ref/hash), planRef, reason, evidenceRefs and an exact directDependents impact list.

D3 — Extend the trusted PR-base selector with a third output `supersessions`. Detection happens before ordinary candidateResearchTask routing checks and recognizes only a canonical candidate reset matching the typed receipt.

D4 — Add `verify-supersession` to trusted `blackboard-jev-ci.mjs` and a sibling `objective-supersession-verify` workflow job. It checks candidate files as data only; no candidate module/command is executed and no provider credential is used.

D5 — Freshness is CAS-like: trustedBaseSha must equal PR base; oldObjective hash must equal trusted-base bytes; target task/objectiveRef/planRef must match trusted Board; any base/objective/routing drift rejects publication.

D6 — Target transition is exact: unfinished RESEARCH_SA -> PLANNED/RESEARCH, claim/currentContext=null; objective path is unchanged but content/hash replaced; current plan becomes DRAFT bound to new objective; remove readinessRef plus evaluationRef/lastEvaluatedInput/evidenceRef/candidateSha/claimEvidence/deliveryRef/merge authority fields.

D7 — Direct impact is complete and conservative. All trusted direct dependents are enumerated exactly once. Non-DONE WORKER/READY dependents must reset to RESEARCH_SA/RESEARCH with DRAFT plan and stale execution/readiness bindings cleared; RESEARCH_SA dependents remain non-active research; DONE dependents are listed TERMINAL_UNCHANGED.
D8 — IDs, feature/topic membership, components and dependency edges are preserved by supersession. This control cannot retitle/reparent work, change execution scope or alter delivered dependencies.

D9 — Retention follows current-only semantics: overwrite the canonical unfinished objective/plan only through the verified publication, retain the canonical supersession receipt, and rely on Git revision history for prior file bodies. No gNNNN/version siblings enter context.

D10 — Repository merge authority is the publication authorization after deterministic verification. Jev evaluates and accepts BB-082's mechanism, but a migration does not ask Jev to judge an objective introduced by that same migration candidate.
D11 — The first consumer is a separate BB-065 migration after BB-082 DONE. That migration may reset its ready direct dependents per D7; it cannot be bundled into the BB-082 worker candidate.
implementationSlices: S1 — Type OBJECTIVE_SUPERSESSION and implement pure trusted-root/candidate-root verification helpers with exact hash/ref/task/dependent-set checks.
S2 — Extend PR selector/output and add `verify-supersession` plus sibling workflow verification without executing candidate code or exposing Jev credentials.
S3 — Enforce target reset and conservative direct-dependent reset semantics, including stale readiness/worker-field stripping and no-active-context invariants.
S4 — Add fixtures for valid reset, stale old objective/base, self-redefinition, hidden/mutated dependents, DONE/WORKER target rejection and history/current-only behavior.
S5 — Update Blackboard/Jev and Living system docs; run repository regression. BB-065 migration remains a separate post-delivery publication.

negativeVerificationCases: Ordinary RESEARCH_SA candidate changes objective bytes/ref or routing and reaches semantic Jev.
Supersession trustedBaseSha differs from exact PR base or old objective hash differs from trusted bytes.
Replacement objective/artifact id/ref/hash or DRAFT plan binding is inconsistent.
Target is DONE, WORKER, ACTIVE after publication, reparented, retitled, or has changed components/dependency edges.
A trusted direct dependent is omitted/duplicated or its declared status/plan hash does not match base.
A ready/WORKER direct dependent remains executable after prerequisite supersession.
Historical objective/plan/evaluation artifacts are rewritten as accepted under the replacement objective.

researchEvidence.finding: Current selector copies Board/objective authority from PR base, allows only plan draft/researchBaseline from research candidate, and recognizes readiness publication as the sole routing mutation.
Current-only keeps one canonical artifact per semantic subject, Git retains revision history, artifact retirement requires explicit supersession, and research cannot claim delivery.
Conditional updates bind the previously observed resource version and reject stale lost updates; BB-082 applies the same freshness shape with trusted PR-base/objective hashes.

Status explicitly identifies the spec generation it reflects; stale observations are detectable rather than silently current. BB-082 similarly clears readiness/execution authority when objective generation changes.
PR base/head SHAs are separately available and head SHA differs from merge-ref SHA; supersession verification therefore binds explicit PR-base trusted state and explicit candidate head.
Immutable full SHAs are the reliable code identity boundary; trusted supersession verification must execute controller code from the base, never candidate code with privileged authority.

supersessionContract.targetPrecondition: trusted target exists, unfinished, lane=RESEARCH_SA; objectiveRef/planRef unchanged and old objective hash exact
supersessionContract.candidatePlan: same canonical planRef, status=DRAFT, objective ref unchanged and hash=replacement objective; no readinessRef
supersessionContract.freshness: receipt.trustedBaseSha == PR base SHA and every old/current hash/Board field matches trusted checkout
supersessionContract.verifier: trusted-base scripts only; candidate is parsed as data; no candidate executable import and no provider credential
supersessionContract.publicationAuthority: repository merge authority after required deterministic checks
supersessionContract.rollback: another explicit supersession from the then-current objective; never rewrite the prior receipt/history

dependentImpactContract.source: exact direct dependency edges from trusted work-graph

dispositions.WORKER_OR_READY: RESET_RESEARCH: preserve id/feature/title/components/dependencies; PLANNED RESEARCH_SA/RESEARCH; DRAFT same plan content/binding subject; clear stale readiness/worker authority
dispositions.RESEARCH_SA: RETAIN_RESEARCH: must be non-active in candidate; exact plan/objective refs preserved; reset claim/context if active
dispositions.DONE: TERMINAL_UNCHANGED: candidate task and terminal artifacts byte-identical

dependentImpactContract.rationale: Objective change can invalidate assumptions behind an already accepted downstream plan; conservative reset prevents silent execution on stale prerequisite semantics.
